preconditions.description: The number of rows in the grid is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
The number of columns in the grid is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
The number of colors is between 1 and the minimum of 40 or the total number of cells in the grid.
The number of missions is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The row indices for the starting and finishing cities are within the grid bounds.
The column indices for the starting and finishing cities are within the grid bounds.

preconditions.expression: For every color between 1 and k, there is at least one city of that color.
preconditions.description: Each color has at least one city in the grid.

postconditions.expression: The output is a list of integers, each representing the minimum time to reach the finishing city from the starting city for a mission.
postconditions.description: The output must provide the minimum time for each mission, where the time is the minimum number of moves Jaber can make to reach the finishing city from the starting city.
